title: Stock montage
summary: A film cut to music from licensed stock or supplied b-roll, with type over picture: a mood film, a manifesto, a brand montage, a sizzle reel.

notFor.when: the user's own recording of their speech, to be cut or captioned
the shots are to be generated by image or video models
an animated film of type, shapes or a mark, with no footage
a film that sells a product or app around its real screens, object or mechanism
an aftermovie or recap of an event the user held or filmed, cut from their own clips
a teaser or trailer that builds to a reveal or a date

qa: Every clip conformed to the film's frame rate, with no judder or repeated frames
Clips share one grade, one light direction and a visual motif across cuts
No identifiable person or brand in a clip implies an endorsement

intake.ask: What is the one idea or line a viewer should say back after watching?
intake.why: Clips are chosen for the idea, not found by keyword; the shot list is written from it
intake.default: proposed at the ideas step for the user to choose

intake.ask: Stock only, your own supplied b-roll, or both? Send the supplied clips and their rights.
intake.why: Supplied clips need footage:shots and a conform; stock needs licence evidence on intake

intake.ask: Is it paid advertising or organic, and may identifiable people or brands appear under the copy?
intake.why: Stock licences forbid implying endorsement; an ad with faces under claims needs releases or faceless shots
intake.default: organic, no identifiable faces under claims

intake.ask: Is there a track or a voiceover script, or shall I propose music at the music step?
intake.why: Music first: every cut sits on its map; a manifesto voiceover sets the cuts instead
intake.default: music only, shortlisted at the music step

intake.ask: Is there a brand grade or LUT the clips must match?
intake.why: One grade across all clips decides which candidates are usable at all
intake.default: one grade chosen at the look step

profiles.note: 16:9 standard; upload at the native frame rate (30). A manifesto with voiceover ships an SRT
9:16 at 1080 x 1920; reframe each clip, never letterbox a landscape cut. A voiceover cut uses clean-sentence captions
9:16 recommended; keep type inside TikTok's safe-zone file
LinkedIn takes 3 s to 15 min at aspect 1:2.4 to 2.4:1 and 10-60 fps; square is the house default for the feed
A muted autoplay header loop: type carries the idea without sound; last frame equals first

starter.note: brutalist-mono is described for manifestos, fashion and music: hero words between shots on hard cuts. A calm mood film starts from warm-editorial instead. film-finish grain over every clip helps mixed sources read as one shoot

variants.title: Manifesto film
variants.changes: Copy-led: a voiceover or type lines set the cuts instead of the music grid alone; the script step comes before the shot list; burned captions (clean-sentence) on vertical cuts; each line's picture is a metaphor, never an illustration of its keyword
